page.layout: One title page, all lines centred: title in large capitals, then a printer's ornament, then the imprint date in two lines at the foot. No running head, page number or signature printed.
page.notes: Not transcribed: the handwritten shelf mark at the top ("Vallen F 1. N° 843"), the handwritten "4" at top right, and the library stamp number at the foot ("A. 5191443"). Show-through from the reverse, a faded italic heading and paragraph ("Typographus Lectori" and the text below it), is also left out. The two printer's ornaments (a floral initial-like device above the title line and a flourish below it) are not text and are not transcribed. The date line "ANNO" is set in decorative script capitals; it is copied as "ANNO". The "Q" in "POPVLVMQVE" and the final period after "Basiliensem" are read with some uncertainty from the scan, but the reading is clear enough to be unmarked.
